data.title: 雷电将军 · 天守阁足汤
data.description: 【雷电将军 · 天守阁足汤】天守阁偏殿的足汤旁点着一盏微光纸灯，泉水清冽而温热。将军将和服下摆微微撩起，莹白的双足没入水中激起圈圈涟漪，回眸望向你时眼角带着一丝娇媚的羞意——「水温刚刚好……你也一同下来吧。只有两个人的时候，无需拘泥君臣之礼。」
data.lighting: warm lantern glow and gentle steam
data.promptProse: A paper lantern glows beside adult Raiden Shogun seated alone on the cedar edge of a private palace foot bath. Her purple kimono has slipped from both shoulders and opened across bare breasts, while the lifted hem reveals thighs above warm water. She raises one wet foot onto the rim and dries its arch with the loose sash, toes curling as violet sparks follow the droplets. Her long braid crosses the bench and calm purple eyes turn back through an unguarded blush. Intimate seated portrait, no text or extra people.
data.nsfwProse: At the pavilion's near edge, a small wooden dipper lies across a wash basin beside the foot bath. Cedar posts lead past the railing toward a dim garden path. A paper lantern at the left post lights the basin rim and bench grain; reflected water places a softer moving highlight under the railing. Raiden Shogun is an adult woman.
